solutionSql:
SELECT r.id AS route_id,
       w.city AS origin_city,
       COUNT(s.id)::integer AS late_shipments
FROM routes AS r
JOIN warehouses AS w ON w.id = r.origin_id
LEFT JOIN shipments AS s
  ON s.route_id = r.id
 AND s.status IN ('queued', 'in_transit')
 AND s.delivery_due < DATE '2026-01-05'
GROUP BY r.id, w.city
ORDER BY r.id;

ambiguities.phrase: still open ... Only queued and in-transit shipments count
ambiguities.readingChosen: status IN (queued, in_transit), exact stored values
ambiguities.alternativeReading: status NOT IN (delivered, cancelled), which would also count any other status value

ambiguities.readingChosen: city of the warehouse referenced by routes.origin_id

notes: LEFT JOIN with the status and date filters in the ON clause keeps zero-count routes; COUNT(s.id) cast to integer. Due date strictly before 2026-01-05. On the sample, route 6 has 8 open shipments due exactly 5 January and correctly shows 0.
